ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the central areas of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation is concentrated at the median notch, trailing edge boundaries, and lateral tips. Irregular black mottling is present in the lower-central section of the left lobe and upper-lateral section of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated as a narrow, deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 45-degree interior angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels. Significant jagged peaks are concentrated at the distal tips, with a series of smaller, rhythmic peaks and valleys along the mid-lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the primary length of the trailing edge, transitioning to a sharp convex trajectory at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast white circular clusters localized at both the left and right lateral tips, indicating barnacle colonization sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, dark, near-parallel diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) located on the mid-to-outer region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy irregular fragmentation and jagged erosion at the distal tips of both lobes; several small, dark focal spots visible near the median notch.
